##### Project general facts

Swoi Berawa presents a stunning two- and three-bedroom villas, thoughtfully crafted by Swoi Development Group for those seeking space, privacy, and prestige in Bali’s most dynamic neighborhood. This exceptional residence is designed for the social, sports, and surf community, offering a generous living area, a private pool, and a prime location within walking distance of world-famous beach clubs and restaurants. With a long-term leasehold structure and quality construction backed by an extensive warranty, the villa represents a secure and hassle-free investment in one of Bali’s most sought-after areas.

The two- and three-bedroom villas are designed to offer the ultimate in comfort and convenience. A private pool and pool deck create a serene outdoor retreat, while abundant natural light and cross ventilation keep the interior fresh and inviting. Durable materials including aluminum, steel, and stone are used throughout, finished to Western standards. An easy-care garden surrounds the property, ensuring effortless maintenance and year-round tropical beauty.

The villas are delivered fully furnished, with interiors designed to maximize space, light, and airflow. The bedroom features a private balcony, while premium plumbing fixtures, built-in wardrobes, and a fully equipped kitchen add to the sense of effortless luxury. Western finishing standards ensure a sleek, contemporary aesthetic, with every detail reflecting an uncompromising commitment to quality. From the spacious living areas to the thoughtfully appointed bedrooms, this villa is a sanctuary of modern tropical living.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Berawa within Badung regency, this exceptional location places residents at the epicenter of Canggu’s social and lifestyle scene. Berawa is renowned as a hub of famous restaurants, bars, beach clubs, and nightclubs, offering top occupancy and rental rates in Bali. Just a short walk from Berawa Beach and its legendary surf spots, the area attracts a vibrant international community of surfers, digital nomads, and creatives.

The location is distinguished by its unbeatable convenience and thriving business environment. Within easy reach are the island’s top three beach clubs, a variety of dining and nightlife venues, clinics, hospitals, and Bali International Airport. The central location allows for quick access to other key areas of the island, making it ideal for both short-term visitors and long-term residents.

For those seeking a residence that embodies energy, convenience, and prestige, Berawa delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, strong rental demand, and vibrant community makes it one of Bali’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where every day feels like a holiday, connected, exciting and effortlessly inspiring.
